dataset.title: A global dataset of SCM-blended concrete and its properties

reported_fields.mixture_inputs: OPC, water, coarse/fine aggregate, fly ash, silica fume, GGBFS and superplasticizer; kg/m3
reported_fields.mechanical_properties: 28-day cylinder compressive strength, splitting tensile strength, flexural strength and elastic modulus
reported_fields.traceability: Mix ID reportedly combines reference number and original experimental label; original-reference links are included.

remaining: Obtain and hash the versioned public workbook and its file manifest; a dynamically empty rendered list is not evidence of zero files.
Audit actual formulation counts, age/state duplicates, current-catalog overlaps and per-property coverage.
Inspect original-reference mapping and compiled-value status; do not relabel compilation as direct experiment by the dataset authors.
Review required compressive/splitting/flexural-strength contracts before using unsupported quantities.
Do not sum ingredient kg/m3 into a purported measured density or import -1 missing sentinels as properties.
Independently review frozen candidates before admission.
